notes: Tidier formatting: sentences ending in a number or time get their full stop, questions like "would it be okay if I came at 4" get a question mark, and documents and AI chats are punctuated even without Smart Format. Emails handle "Hey, how are you?", "kind regards" and a sign-off like "thanks heaps Joe" properly, and spoken addresses like "joe at gmail dot com" become real ones. "Step one, step two…" makes a list, "at 3 no sorry 4" becomes "at 4", and "uh-huh" is kept.
